# Grok Bot

> Community guide for xAI / Cursor Grok Bot: how to start, first job, one shared computer, plan conflicts, and Recover before Reset. Not grok.com chat, not Grok Build, not grok-app.

Official product: https://x.ai/bot
Official docs: https://docs.x.ai/grok-bot/overview
This site: https://grokbot.run/

## Dots (unofficial)

- [OpenAI dots](https://grokbot.run/openai-dots/): how to turn one on, eligibility, and how it differs from Grok Bot and Muse. Not an OpenAI page. /dots/ redirects here.
- [Dots pricing](https://grokbot.run/dots-pricing/): no separate price sheet in the sources.
- [Dots release date](https://grokbot.run/dots-release-date/): 29 September 2026.
- [Dots download](https://grokbot.run/dots-download/): no separate installer in the reports.
- [Dots waitlist](https://grokbot.run/dots-waitlist/): texting waitlist only.
- [Dots vs Grok Bot](https://grokbot.run/dots-vs-grokbot/)
- [Dots vs Muse](https://grokbot.run/dots-vs-muse/)
- [Dots alternatives](https://grokbot.run/dots-alternatives/)
- [Dots FAQ](https://grokbot.run/dots-faq/)
- [What is Muse](https://grokbot.run/muse/): Meta's personal agent, how to start it, and reported price. Not a Meta page.
- [Muse vs](https://grokbot.run/muse-vs/)
- [Muse alternatives](https://grokbot.run/muse-alternatives/)
- [How to get OpenAI dots](https://grokbot.run/how-to-get-openai-dots/): plan, region, rollout, and setup order from OpenAI's Help Center.
- [Dots vs ChatGPT](https://grokbot.run/dots-vs-chatgpt/): how a dot differs from a ChatGPT chat, and what Anthropic publishes about Claude Cowork.
- [Dots security and privacy](https://grokbot.run/dots-security-privacy/): sandboxing, secure sign-in, Auto-review, training settings, and OpenAI's own tests.
- [Muse vs Grok Bot](https://grokbot.run/muse-vs-grok-bot/): row-by-row from each company's own pages, plus how to choose.

## Start

- [Guide](https://grokbot.run/): how to start, login, plans, fixes
- Header Find on every page: type a page, symptom, or tool name. Results jump to an existing URL. `/?q=` opens the same lookup. There is no separate /search/ page.
- [Handbook](https://grokbot.run/learn/): lessons in order
- [What is Grok Bot](https://grokbot.run/learn/what-is-grok-bot/): not grok.com
- [Install and login](https://grokbot.run/learn/install/)
- [Mac download](https://grokbot.run/learn/mac-download/): Apple silicon or Intel
- [Windows download](https://grokbot.run/learn/windows-download/): x64 or Arm64
- [iPhone, iPad, and Android](https://grokbot.run/learn/phone-download/)
- [Cursor login](https://grokbot.run/learn/login/): no separate Grok Bot account
- [Cursor and Grok Bot](https://grokbot.run/learn/cursor/): one account, two apps
- [First Bot](https://grokbot.run/learn/first-bot/)
- [After week one](https://grokbot.run/learn/operator/): manage a roster from named field posts
- [X, Cursor, MCP](https://grokbot.run/learn/ops/): official X plugin as research, Cloud Agent for the repo, remote MCP
- [Skills and routines](https://grokbot.run/learn/skills-routines/)
- [Shared computer](https://grokbot.run/learn/computer/)
- [Plugins and MCP](https://grokbot.run/learn/plugins/)
- [Usage and On-Demand](https://grokbot.run/learn/cost-and-pitfalls/)
- [Pricing](https://grokbot.run/pricing/): no invented list prices
- [Glossary](https://grokbot.run/learn/glossary/)

## Facts this site will not invent

- Isolation is per user, not per Bot. All Bots share one computer.
- There is no separate Grok Bot account. Login is Cursor.
- Weekly usage can spill into On-Demand.
- Self-hosted GitHub repos are not unofficial official clients.
